atomicity.mechanism: PostgreSQL transaction blocks via SQLAlchemy session.commit() / session.rollback() and explicit BEGIN / COMMIT blocks in schema DDL
atomicity.verification_evidence: Stage 3 Concurrency Scenario B & Error Handling Tests: when duplicate key violation or constraint failure occurs, db.rollback() rolls back the entire attempt, leaving zero partial state in database. Validated by conftest.py clean_test_database fixture.

consistency.mechanism: 130 database constraints: NOT NULL, CHECK constraints (e.g. quantity >= 0, reserved_quantity <= quantity, sold_quantity <= stock_limit, starts_at < ends_at), FOREIGN KEY cascades and RESTRICT rules, UNIQUE indexes
consistency.verification_evidence: Scenario A demonstrated that sold_quantity could never exceed stock_limit (10/10 sold, 40 rejected with 409). Negative inventory is mathematically and relationally impossible.

isolation.mechanism: Engine default: READ COMMITTED. High-contention purchase transactions explicitly acquire row-level exclusive locks: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on flash_sale_products and simulation_inventory, serialized by PostgreSQL tuple lock manager.
isolation.verification_evidence: Stage 3 Scenario A (50 threads) and Scenario E (30 threads) executed without dirty reads, lost updates, or serialization anomalies. Did not require global SERIALIZABLE isolation aborts.

durability.mechanism: PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) and synchronous commit. Cloud persistence via Render Managed PostgreSQL disk volume.
durability.verification_evidence: Stage 3 Disaster Recovery Drill: backup acquisition (0.266s) and restoration (0.225s) into flashcore_recovery_test confirmed 100% data parity across stores, users, and simulation_runs.
